lines.gurmukhi: ਤੰਤ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ ਅਉਖਧ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਊ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ta(n)t ma(n)tr sabh aukhadh jaanahi a(n)t taoo maranaa ||2||
lines.translation: those who know Tantras and mantras and all medicines - even they shall die in the end. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਭੋਗ ਅਰੁ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਬਹੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਰਮਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaj bhog ar chhatr si(n)ghaasan bahu su(n)dar ramanaa ||
lines.translation: Those who enjoy regal power and rule, royal canopies and thrones, many beautiful women,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਨ ਕਪੂਰ ਸੁਬਾਸਕ ਚੰਦਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਊ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: paan kapoor subaasak cha(n)dan a(n)t taoo maranaa ||3||
lines.translation: betel nuts, camphor and fragrant sandalwood oil - in the end, they too shall die. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਭ ਖੋਜੇ ਕਹੂ ਨ ਊਬਰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed puraan si(n)mrit sabh khoje kahoo na oobaranaa ||
lines.translation: I have searched all the Vedas, Puraanas and Simritees, but none of these can save anyone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਉ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਜੰਪਉ ਮੇਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer iu raamahi ja(n)pau met janam maranaa ||4||5||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, meditate on the Lord, and eliminate birth and death. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਫੀਲੁ ਰਬਾਬੀ ਬਲਦੁ ਪਖਾਵਜ ਕਊਆ ਤਾਲ ਬਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pheel rabaabee balad pakhaavaj kaooaa taal bajaavai ||
lines.translation: The elephant is the guitar player, the ox is the drummer, and the crow plays the cymbals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਰਿ ਚੋਲਨਾ ਗਦਹਾ ਨਾਚੈ ਭੈਸਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pahir cholanaa gadahaa naachai bhaisaa bhagat karaavai ||1||
lines.translation: Putting on the skirt, the donkey dances around, and the water buffalo performs devotional worship. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕਕਰੀਆ ਬਰੇ ਪਕਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: raajaa raam kakareeaa bare pakaae ||
lines.translation: The Lord, the King, has cooked the cakes of ice,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਨੈ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰੈ ਖਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kinai boojhanahaarai khaae ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: but only the rare man of understanding eats them. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੈਠਿ ਸਿੰਘੁ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਨ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਘੀਸ ਗਲਉਰੇ ਲਿਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: baith si(n)gh ghar paan lagaavai ghees galaure liaavai ||
lines.translation: Sitting in his den, the lion prepares the betel leaves, and the muskrat brings the betel nuts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੁਸਰੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਛੂਆ ਸੰਖੁ ਬਜਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ghar ghar musaree ma(n)gal gaavahi kachhooaa sa(n)kh bajaavai ||2||
lines.translation: Going from house to house, the mouse sings the songs of joy, and the turtle blows on the conch-shell. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਸ ਕੋ ਪੂਤੁ ਬੀਆਹਨ ਚਲਿਆ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਛਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)s ko poot beeaahan chaliaa suine ma(n)dap chhaae ||
lines.translation: The son of the sterile woman goes to get married, and the golden canopy is spread out for him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਬੇਧੀ ਸਸੈ ਸਿੰਘ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: roop ka(n)niaa su(n)dar bedhee sasai si(n)gh gun gaae ||3||
lines.translation: He marries a beautiful and enticing young woman; the rabbit and the lion sing their praises. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕੀਟੀ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu keetee parabat khaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - the ant has eaten the mountain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਛੂਆ ਕਹੈ ਅੰਗਾਰ ਭਿ ਲੋਰਉ ਲੂਕੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: kachhooaa kahai a(n)gaar bh lorau lookee sabad sunaaiaa ||4||6||
lines.translation: The turtle says, "I need a burning coal, also." Listen to this mystery of the Shabad. ||4||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਟੂਆ ਏਕੁ ਬਹਤਰਿ ਆਧਾਰੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: batooaa ek bahatar aadhaaree eko jisahi duaaraa ||
lines.translation: The body is a bag with seventy-two chambers, and one opening, the Tenth Gate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਵੈ ਖੰਡ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਮਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਗਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: navai kha(n)d kee prithamee maagai so jogee jag saaraa ||1||
lines.translation: He alone is a real Yogi on this earth, who asks for the primal world of the nine regions. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa jogee nau nidh paavai ||
lines.translation: Such a Yogi obtains the nine treasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਲ ਕਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੇ ਗਗਨਿ ਚਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tal kaa braham le gagan charaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He lifts his soul up from below, to the skies of the Tenth Gate. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਈ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਾਗਾ ਮਥਿ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: khi(n)thaa giaan dhiaan kar sooee sabad taagaa math ghaalai ||
lines.translation: He makes spiritual wisdom his patched coat, and meditation his needle. He twists the thread of the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਰਗਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch tat kee kar miragaanee gur kai maarag chaalai ||2||
lines.translation: Making the five elements his deer skin to sit on, he walks on the Guru's Path. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਫਾਹੁਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਧੂਈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa phaahuree kaaiaa kar dhooee drisat kee agan jalaavai ||
lines.translation: He makes compassion his shovel, his body the firewood, and he kindles the fire of divine vision.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਾਉ ਲਏ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tis kaa bhaau lae rid a(n)tar chahu jug taaRee laavai ||3||
lines.translation: He places love within his heart, and he remains in deep meditation throughout the four ages. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਜੋਗਤਣ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jogatan raam naam hai jis kaa pi(n)d paraanaa ||
lines.translation: All Yoga is in the Name of the Lord; the body and the breath of life belong to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer je kirapaa dhaarai dei sachaa neesaanaa ||4||7||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, if God grants His Grace, He bestows the insignia of Truth. ||4||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਏ ਕਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hi(n)doo turak kahaa te aae kin eh raah chalaaee ||
lines.translation: Where have the Hindus and Muslims come from? Who put them on their different paths?

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਚਿ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਕਵਾਦੇ ਭਿਸਤ ਦੋਜਕ ਕਿਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dil mahi soch bichaar kavaade bhisat dojak kin paaee ||1||
lines.translation: Think of this, and contemplate it within your mind, O men of evil intentions. Who will go to heaven and hell? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀ ਤੈ ਕਵਨ ਕਤੇਬ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaajee tai kavan kateb bakhaanee ||
lines.translation: O Qazi, which book have you read?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜ੍ਹਤ ਗੁਨਤ ਐਸੇ ਸਭ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: paRhat gunat aise sabh maare kinahoo(n) khabar na jaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Such scholars and students have all died, and none of them have discovered the inner meaning. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਕਤਿ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਕਰੀਐ ਮੈ ਨ ਬਦਉਗਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sakat sanehu kar su(n)nat kareeai mai na badaugaa bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Because of the love of woman, circumcision is done; I don't believe in it, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਰੇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੁਰਕੁ ਕਰੈਗਾ ਆਪਨ ਹੀ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jau re khudaai mohi turak karaigaa aapan hee kat jaaee ||2||
lines.translation: If God wished me to be a Muslim, it would be cut off by itself. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਕੀਏ ਤੁਰਕੁ ਜੇ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਅਉਰਤ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)nat keee turak je hoigaa aurat kaa kiaa kareeai ||
lines.translation: If circumcision makes one a Muslim, then what about a woman?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਰਧ ਸਰੀਰੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਹੀ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aradh sareeree naar na chhodai taa te hi(n)doo hee raheeai ||3||
lines.translation: She is the other half of a man's body, and she does not leave him, so he remains a Hindu. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਕਤੇਬ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜੁ ਬਉਰੇ ਜੁਲਮ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhaad kateb raam bhaj baure julam karat hai bhaaree ||
lines.translation: Give up your holy books, and remember the Lord, you fool, and stop oppressing others so badly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰੈ ਪਕਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਤੁਰਕ ਰਹੇ ਪਚਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: kabeerai pakaree tek raam kee turak rahe pachihaaree ||4||8||
lines.translation: Kabeer has grasped hold of the Lord's Support, and the Muslims have utterly failed. ||4||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤੇਲੁ ਦੀਵੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਤੀ ਤਬ ਸੂਝੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab lag tel deeve mukh baatee tab soojhai sabh koee ||
lines.translation: As long as the oil and the wick are in the lamp, everything is illuminated.
